text:
Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with an HTTP 502 error. All other API requests completed without errors.

A software deployment at 14:02 UTC removed the cache warmup step from the system startup sequence. As a result, API servers received traffic before the cache contained required data. This caused high server load and HTTP 502 responses.

Engineers identified the root cause and reverted the deployment at 14:27 UTC. The system restored cache warmup, and the error rate decreased immediately.

By 14:31 UTC, all API services operated normally. We will review our deployment procedures to make sure that future updates require cache warmup verification.
